description.en: Official website for Chika Idol Group, solving the need for a centralized platform to keep fans updated on schedules, members, and news. Built with React, Supabase, and Tailwind.

technologies: React, Node.js, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, AOS.js

description.en: A zero-commission ticketing platform built to eliminate the hassle of manual ticket recap for Event Organizers. Handles real-time bookings efficiently. Built with React, Express, and Supabase.
description.id: Platform ticketing zero-commission yang dibangun untuk menghilangkan pusingnya rekap manual bagi Event Organizer. Mengelola pemesanan tiket secara real-time. (React, Vite, Tailwind, Node.js, Supabase)

technologies: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Supabase

description.en: Desktop automation software designed to speed up video processing and media generation for content creators, automating repetitive tasks. Built with Electron, React, and FFmpeg.
description.id: Software automasi desktop untuk mempercepat pemrosesan video bagi content creator, menghilangkan tugas repetitif secara otomatis. (Electron, React, FFmpeg)

technologies: Node.js, React, Electron, FFmpeg, Tailwind CSS

technologies: React, Vite, Node.js, Admin Dashboard, Data Analytics
